claim_4.claim: Microarray analysis of peripheral blood RNA samples from healthy volunteers ages 18 to 40 years in discovery (males) and validation (females) cohorts, collected on days 0, 1, 3, and 14 after vaccination, using additive genotype-effect modeling and delta-Rg2 analysis, showed that multiple loci had genetic effects on expression that were enhanced or only apparent after vaccination compared to baseline.

sources.quote: We then identified the SNP-transcript pairs in which the expression variance explained was most strongly increased after vaccination (highest change in genetic variance explained, which we termed delta-Rg2). This analysis revealed multiple loci at which the genetic effect was either enhanced or only apparent after the experimental perturbation.

claim_6.claim: Microarray analysis of peripheral blood RNA samples from healthy volunteers ages 18 to 40 years in discovery (males) and validation (females) cohorts, collected on days 0 and 3 after vaccination, using cis-eQTL analysis of SNP-transcript pairs that show a strong cis-eQTL and a transcriptional response to vaccination, showed that an increase in the genetic effect (R2g) after vaccination was a general feature of the SNP-transcript pairs that show a strong cis-eQTL and a transcriptional response to vaccination compared to baseline.

sources.quote: and that this amplitude change was a general feature of the loci in which we observed both a strong cis-acting eQTL and a transcriptional response to the vaccine stimulus.

(B) An increase in R2g after the experimental perturbation is a general feature of the SNP-transcript pairs that show a strong cis-eQTLs and a transcriptional response to vaccination (left). The within-genotype variance is unchanged (MSE, center), while the strength of the genotype effect on expression (slope of the additive association; β, right) increases, suggesting that the latter is the main driver for the observed increase in the genetic effect after vaccination.

claim_16.claim: Microarray analysis of peripheral blood RNA samples from healthy volunteers ages 18 to 40 years in the discovery and validation cohorts, obtained on days 0, 1, 3, and 14 after vaccination on day 0, using extended causal modeling with independent-versus-reactive and independent-versus-causal hypothesis tests, showed that patterns in the 137 eQTL SNP-transcript pairs from the 20 loci with the strongest evidence of genetic variation influencing the immune response to the vaccine trended toward the causal model compared to the reactive model.

sources.quote: We found that the patterns in the data trend toward the causal model compared to the reactive model (Figure 7B), but a power analysis based on the distribution of the empirical effect sizes of our observed associations also indicates that our sample size is too modest to support definitive conclusions (Figure 7C).

(B) p-values for independent-versus-reactive and independent-versus-causal hypothesis tests. Each point shows the result for one SNP-transcript pair. Points to the right of the solid vertical line are significant (p<0.05) for the reactive hypothesis and points above the solid horizontal line are significant for the causal hypothesis. The dashed line shows a p=0.1 threshold.
